The monthly bar values are approximately January 149, February 128, March 133, relatively high in late winter and early spring; from April to September most are below 100, among which June is about 60, July 77, and August 73, making it a low-value period; after October it rises again, and November and December are about 126. Then reason: The question stem asks to explain the possible related factors for the seasonal variation in Denmark's annual wind power generation in 2007. Therefore, this seasonal variation may be related to the north-south movement of the direct solar point.
